FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
Broken-plus-solid yellow lets the broken side pass, while double solid yellow lets neither side pass [A01].
Why it matters: group yellow-lines; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F01, sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Broken yellow divides opposing directions with passing allowed, while broken white divides same-direction lanes with changes allowed [A01].
Why it matters: group yellow-lines; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F11, sec05-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
From the solid-yellow side you may cross only for pedestrians, bicyclists, or scooter and skateboard riders with the far lane clear [A01].
Why it matters: group yellow-lines; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F01, sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A01
Broken white opens free lane changes, while dotted white steers lanes through intersections and ramps [A01].
Why it matters: group white-lines; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F03, sec05-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A01
Message boards issue directions to obey, while rumble strips issue a surface to cross slowly and straight [A01].
Why it matters: group road-messages; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F06, sec05-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A02
A center lane broken on both sides allows passing from either way, while a center lane solid-plus-broken allows only left turns within one hundred fifty feet [A02].
Why it matters: group center-lanes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F14, sec05-F15 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A02
A sharrow shares a narrow lane with bikes riding in it, while a bike lane reserves its space with entry only for turns [A02].
Why it matters: group bike-space; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F16, sec05-F17 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A02
A curved arrow alone or with ONLY forces the turn, while a curved plus straight arrow offers turn or straight [A02].
Why it matters: group white-lines; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F19 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A02
Yield triangles mark a yield-or-stop point, while white stop lines, crosswalks, and parking marks fix exact positions [A02].
Why it matters: group white-lines; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F12, sec05-F18 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A03
Center diamonds open HOV lanes to qualified high-occupancy travel, while BUS ONLY paint and red pavement close bus lanes to all but buses [A03].
Why it matters: group reserved-lanes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F24, sec05-F23, sec05-F25 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A03
Purple-logo lanes serve transponder holders and cash lanes serve the rest, while high-speed transponder lanes punish a mistaken entry with no stopping [A03].
Why it matters: group toll-lanes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F26, sec05-F27 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A03
White curbs serve passenger pickup and dropoff, yellow curbs serve loading with the driver present, and red curbs ban stopping, standing, and parking [A03].
Why it matters: group curb-code; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F28 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]
